summary: Nearest-neighbor traversal over a linked chain of physics nodes. Computes the squared distance from the query position (this+0/4/8) to the first node, then walks node+272 child links while the cumulative path length (sum of node+60 values) stays below 200.0 (flt_59E470). Descends when a child's squared distance is strictly smaller than the current best; early-outs and returns the current node otherwise, or returns the child immediately when it has no further child. A null start node returns itself unchanged. Called by AISteering (004270A0).

local_names.a2: start node of the linked chain
local_names.v16: accumulated path length along the chain

operations.description: Null guard: when a2 (start node) is 0 the function returns a2 immediately without traversing
Seed squared distance v15 from the query position this+0/4/8 against the first node's position fields (node+148/152/156)

Chain traversal: while the current node has a child at node+272, accumulate node+60 into the path length v16, compute the child's squared distance, and descend when it is strictly below the current best v15
Path-length guard: traversal stops when the accumulated path length v16 exceeds 200.0, the threshold held by flt_59E470
Spatial-culling guard: when the child's squared distance is >= the current best v15, traversal stops and the current node is returned
Returns the closest node v4, or the child v10 immediately when that child has no further child at node+272; the function is called by AISteering (004270A0)
